Master coordinates shared prerequisites and fresh independent review. No integration/product PR/tag/release. Tests only mutate owned temporary stores/worktrees/configurations.

Implement all six exact Storage methods. Constructor binds the explicitly supplied user config/preferences locations once and rejects overlapping family bindings; run config receives Git-issued exact WorktreeScope and only the literal .gh-tree/run.json store. Versions bind family/store parent/root/worktree/presence/whole byte length+SHA256; opaque tokens are not decoded into ambient filesystem authority. Load performs no directory creation/migration/default writes. Missing parents use the accepted nearest-existing-anchor/remaining-literal-components absence binding; commit reacquires/revalidates and safely creates/adopts only scope-conforming components. For a missing-parent transition, retain the original expected-absence anchor token in the native manifest/authorization evidence; shared RecoveryRecord.Original may describe the guarded prepublication absence reobserved under the now-established parent, with Proposed bound to that same physical store. Do not erase the original request precondition or claim an unchecked cross-store transition. Prove this native transition explicitly. Return absent default candidate plus expected-absence version only when absence is actually proved; corrupt/unsupported/unavailable states never yield writable defaults.

Implement complete strict private schema0/schema1 codec into accepted immutable API documents. Preserve exact known UTF8/alias/path/script/ordered target bytes, missing/null/explicit-empty distinctions (only StripPrefixes admits Null), all nested unknown JSON members/providers/noncurrent scope entries and exact original raw bytes. Enforce4MiB/depth64, duplicate keys at every depth, invalidUTF8, malformed/reserved shapes and unknown positive schema versions without wrap/default/rewrite. Scope tokens serialize unambiguously without claiming observed repository association. Application decides migration/active/default/alias/intent patches; storage structurally validates complete proposed documents and retained unknown members under the guarded expected version, no stale merge or arbitrary legacy/casefold winner.

Use retained nofollow parent objects and handle-relative native operations throughout. Unix Openat/Fstatat/Renameat/Linkat and explicit ACL/xattr platform detection preserve original object scope under movement, refusing observed drift and substituted path. Windows NtCreateFile RootDirectory/OBJ_DONT_REPARSE/reparse inspection with actual directory list/data-read guards and no-delete sharing; no metadata-only guard or path-join/reopen fallback. Reject unsupported special/network/cloud/FUSE/security profiles before unsafe writes. Handles are noninheritable and follow the frozen request-owner acquisition/join/close contract; no native handles/locks cross the public port or remain held by a request across UI delay.

Implement permanent never-unlinked per-store lock: Windows LockFileEx byte0 length1; Unix keyed in-process mutex plus flock, bounded cancellable <=5s acquisition. Kernel ownership, not PID/mtime/age, releases it. Under lock compare whole expected document, reserve bounded recovery admission (256 records or1GiB initial construction limits), prepare exclusive nonce payload+manifest, exact raw-byte backup and no-replace hardlink to observed original, verify identities/security/write lengths/flush/close. Preserve both immutable raw backup and potentially late-written retained original inode.

Native commit point is Windows NT class65 FileRenameInformationEx retained payload/RootDirectory/basename (REPLACE_IF_EXISTS|POSIX for present; flags0 no-replace for absent) and class11 hardlink retention with architecture-correct layout, or Unix Renameat expected-present/Linkat no-replace expected-absent with file+directory barriers. Windows owner/group/ordered DACL/protection/inheritance/labels/CAP/read-only semantics require explicit copy/verification/refusal; new per-user protected ACL and project inherited access, no0600-as-ACL assumption. Unix uid/gid/mode plus native Linux/Darwin/FreeBSD ACL/xattr support/detection is explicit. No truncate, unsupported fallback or automatic retention eviction.

Preserve exact native outcome and independent known effects/errors/cancellation/recovery. Known Windows success is CommittedDurabilityUncertain; known Unix success plus required barriers is Committed, postcommit failure cannot erase publication; lost native return remains Indeterminate despite later equal bytes. Shared RecoveryID issued once/persisted per artifact survives restart and all typed StorageRecovery family/subject/locator/SourceVersion versus original/proposed StorageVersion detail. No retry/replay/age purge or historical causality inference. Cooperative writers have whole-document CAS; arbitrary external-editor final-compare/publication gap remains an explicit limitation and tested case, not a universal transaction claim. No cross-store transaction/background flush/active selection/provider execution.

Verification covers V-PER-01..04 and related Application/Discovery/Composition/Slice clauses at exact source. Real multiple processes/stores, native readers, missing parent/absence competitors, foreign family/root versions, bound-directory move/reparse/path conversion, same-byte restoration/content drift, all codec/migration unknown-member fixtures, held-open late writes, permissions/sharing/unsupported metadata, lock and recovery capacity, retained ID reload and every preparation/native-call/flush/close/outcome-delivery fault/crash boundary. Record actual Windows/Linux/macOS and FreeBSD metadata/mechanism execution for claimed profiles; all12 builds and layout assertions are distinct from native evidence. Existing design probes are inputs only. If shared CI support is needed, request Master-coordinated Composition scope rather than edit workflows.

Freeze/push complete source and actual tests/CI/native evidence/limitations. Separate fresh reviewer reopens actual code/contracts/tests/SHA and adversarial/positive controls; correct/re-review before acceptance. Master integrates after accepted Git/GitHub and before Discovery/Runtime with exact integrated CI. No full Slice/baseline finding closure from a folder or codec suite. A deficient frozen contract requires explicit BC-CHANGE before affected implementation.

Implementation evidence must map each layer-owned clause to actual source/tests/platforms. Dependent Application/State/View/full-stack portions remain explicit later gates; this does not waive any native requirement owned by this contribution. Master alone declares contribution/Slice completion from independent review and verified integration.
